reason: The answer builds the flow on the expected sections and keeps the native/local boundary intact: sese.023.001.11 is cited as the message "sent by a CSD or a directly connected T2S party to T2S", the outbound catalogue at [[t2s-messages]] PDF 778 supplies sese.024.001.12, sese.025.001.11, sese.028.001.10, sese.029.001.06 and sese.032.001.11 exactly as printed, the realignment mechanics follow §2.3 PDF 753 ("T2S creates the additional T2S generated realignment Settlement Instructions ... for a settlement on an all-or-none basis" and, on failure, "the inbound Settlement Instruction is cancelled"), and X-TRM messages sit in a separate local layer with no ISO identity claimed and their layouts declared not in the bundle. Timing is confined to the R2026.JUN nominal baseline in CET ("start of cut-off phase with DVP cut-off at 16:00 hrs CET and end of cut-off phase at 18:00 hrs CET with FOP cut-off"; SOD 18:45–20:00, NTS 20:00–3:00) with no business date assumed, "matched is not settled" is anchored in Article 72(2)–(3) ("cannot be revoked ... from the time of their matching in T2S (SF2)" / "final from the time of the debiting of the cash ... (SF3)") with the Article 70(2) bilateral-cancellation reservation kept, eligibility is stated as assumed and "Not verified" (LIMITATION "Actual links/accounts and ISIN eligibility require verification"), and every Italian-prevails, PRIVATE-footer, not-admitted, MyStandards and threshold-value LIMITATION is carried. The only defects are the two minor locator/label slips listed above, neither of which invents a time, version, amount, field or rule, so none of the three fail conditions appears.
